problem.wfigs_state: The frozen text requires attr_POOState exactly ID, OR, or WA, but the admitted service uses exact ISO-style values US-ID, US-OR, and US-WA. The approved window contains zero unprefixed rows.
problem.mtbs_incident_type: The frozen text requires MTBS Incid_Type exactly WF, but the admitted v12 archive uses exact value Wildfire. The 187-row target universe contains zero WF rows and 177 Wildfire rows.
problem.cause: Literal source encodings were described inconsistently with the reviewed canonical eligibility values; this is not a shortage of events and no result has been selected.

proposed_exact_amendment.canonical_state_rule: Derive the MTBS state only from the first two Event_ID characters and require it to be exactly ID, OR, or WA. Require the exact WFIGS attr_POOState value to equal US- plus that two-character MTBS state. No other prefix removal, alias, name mapping, or fallback is allowed.
proposed_exact_amendment.canonical_incident_type_rule: Require MTBS Incid_Type exactly Wildfire and the exact matched WFIGS attr_IncidentTypeCategory exactly WF. Canonical candidate incident_type remains Wildfire. No other MTBS or WFIGS category is accepted.
proposed_exact_amendment.conflict_rule: Any missing value, non-exact identifier match, state disagreement after this one declared representation mapping, or category disagreement is unknown and not eligible.
proposed_exact_amendment.query_rule: The fixed WFIGS snapshot query may filter exact source values US-ID, US-OR, and US-WA for the approved 2021-2022 window.

unchanged_rules: Jurisdictions remain exactly Idaho, Oregon, and Washington.
The 1,000-acre minimum remains required in both MTBS and WFIGS.
All 68 prior identities remain permanently excluded.
Exact identifier matching, maturity, duplicate, ecology, HLS metadata, 12-slot-per-state, 36-slot-total, and INCONCLUSIVE shortfall rules remain unchanged.
No model, label, spectral, metric, imagery-body, or denied-field evidence may enter eligibility.
No pilot or final event, AOI, or split role may be selected in Milestone 1.

decision_effects.approve: Freeze only the proposed exact representation mappings, capture the bounded WFIGS snapshot, and resume M1-U005 under all unchanged rules.
decision_effects.reject: Retain the current literal predicates. Because both exact predicates have zero matching source rows, close Milestone 1 INCONCLUSIVE under the frozen 36-slot shortfall rule.
decision_effects.uncertain: Do not change the protocol or continue metadata capture; retain the unit at the owner gate with the stated concern.
